usageNotes: Lists all named IP sets defined in a VM's guest-level firewall. Use this before creating or referencing an IP set in firewall rules to confirm the set exists and retrieve its digest for safe concurrent-edit protection. Requires VM.Audit on the VM path; the node must be online and the QEMU guest must exist.

examples.summary: List all firewall IP sets for VM 110 on node pve1

tips: Each returned object includes a 'digest' field — pass it to write operations (create/update/delete on IP set entries) to prevent race conditions with concurrent modifications.
An empty array means no IP sets have been created for this VM's guest firewall yet; guest-level IP sets are separate from cluster-level IP sets.
IP set names follow the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+ — useful to know when scripting lookups by name.
